emails.subject: afternoon clinic rooms at verdun
emails.a: Quick question about Verdun Medical Center: are any clinic rooms free in the afternoons or on certain weekdays? On ProHost, doctors, psychologists and physiotherapists book clinic rooms by the shift, and you approve every request first.
emails.b: Clinic rooms that sit empty after the morning shift still cost Verdun Medical Center rent and staff time. ProHost rents them by the shift to phone-verified doctors and therapists, with live availability so no slot is booked twice.
emails.c: As clinic manager, you could turn Verdun Medical Center's quiet afternoons into steady income. Medical centers on ProHost rent rooms by the shift or month to specialists across Lebanon and keep every booking fee.
